<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 5:1:4">Y. B. Mets. V, beg. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>יותר מיכן וי למ׳</he> if prices rise above that, woe to the seller (on time).
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:10">Esth. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>ווי ליה למְזַבְּנֵיה</he> (not <he>למיזב׳</he>) woe to him who sells it (the king’s purple).
